transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Well, I'm here because... honestly, since my in-laws moved into our house, things have just been falling apart for me. I've been so keyed up and just completely worn down by the whole situation. 

It's getting pretty bad. I find myself constantly snapping at my wife, which isn't like me. And it's really starting to hit my work. I manage artists for a living, and lately, I've been avoiding calls that I would normally handle immediately. I actually... I nearly let a musician’s contract completely fall apart the other day just because I couldn’t think straight. I just really need to get a handle on this before it ruins my career and my marriage.
How long have you been experiencing these feelings?
It's been about a month now. Pretty much exactly since they moved into our house.
Over the past month, have you been feeling persistently down, depressed, or hopeless?

No, I wouldn't really say I feel depressed or hopeless. It's not... I'm not really sad. It's more just this constant stress and feeling completely on edge all the time. But no, I haven't been feeling down like that.
Did you struggle with feeling on edge or anxious like this before your in-laws moved in?

No, not at all. I was functioning completely normally before they got here. I mean, work is always a little busy, but I handled it just fine. This whole thing... feeling this anxious and on edge, it really just started within a few weeks of them taking over the house.
